reply.analysis: Nothing is proven exactly: the verdict is a gap with bracket [455, 534]. The lower bound 455 comes from an independent set (check passed) and the upper bound 534 from a clique cover of 534 cliques (check passed). The one code tried did not beat 534, as expected: the graph is irregular (degrees 481-495) and its spectrum is non-integral, so a Kneser K(16,4) code does not carry over. Against the baselines the agent finished in 126.5 s wall (92.8 s compute, 33.7 s LLM). It matched cpsat_alpha's 455 (unproven, 123.0 s) and had a much tighter upper bound than frac_cover (1800), kushagra_agent (1818, 176.7 s) and cpsat_cover (none). f2_minrank_sat gave a floor of 454 in 1.2 s, which is far faster and only 1 below. Nothing looks suspicious.
